column7: A mongodb admin_dsn with tls=true&tlsInsecure=true (alias sslInsecure, any option-name case) satisfied the operator's TLS requirement while the driver accepted any certificate and hostname, so a project admin could undo dynamic_secrets.insecure_allow_plaintext_dynamic_secret_transport (same class as the Redis skip_verify refusal, #4372/#4373). connectMongo now refuses InsecureSkipVerify on the parsed driver options (dsn.ForbiddenOptionError, option tlsInsecure, DSN not quoted) unless insecure transport is allowed (then a WARNING); Revoke drops the option and keeps verification on (TestMongoEngine_Revoke_InsecureTLSOptionIsDroppedNotRefused). Also closes a downgrade next to it: the TLS check read option names as written but the driver lower-cases them, so a mongodb+srv admin_dsn with TLS=false or SSL=false connected in clear (TestConnectMongo_TLSOffSpellingsCannotDowngrade, TestMongoTLSEnabled_ReadsOptionsLikeTheDriver). tlsAllowInvalidCertificates and tlsAllowInvalidHostnames are not read by the pinned driver; class guard TestConnectMongo_NoSpellingTurnsVerificationOffUnrefused fails if a driver upgrade starts honouring them unrefused. postgres and mysql came under the same policy later (SQL-DSN-TRANSPORT-POLICY-1). Red before the change, green after.
